origin.description: Sum of exponentials fitted by separable least squares.
origin.usage: mexpfit(x, y, p0, w = NULL, const = TRUE, options = list())

arguments.name: p0
arguments.text: Starting rates. Duplicates are dropped. Zero is rejected.

arguments.name: const
arguments.text: Include a constant term when true.

arguments.name: options
arguments.text: tau, tolx, tolg, and maxeval. Unspecified keys keep the mexpfit defaults.

origin.details: 1 + 2 exp(-0.5 x) on 12 points from 0 to 2, started at -0.4.
origin.value: Sum of exponentials fitted by separable least squares.
origin.example: local({x<-seq(0, 2, length.out=12); y<-1+2*exp(-0.5*x); with(mexpfit(x, y, p0=-0.4), c(a0, a, b, ssq))})
